reviewer: Codex: side diagnostic sheets and final light/dark 32-frame sheets inspected
limits: Local original procedural demonstrations. Sampled surface clearance is not exhaustive collision or biomechanical certification; physical device and production pending.

checks.exercise: Floor-start barbell deadlift with a distinct ascent pause below knees.
checks.equipment: One rigid barbell with two equal round plates; full equipment visible in both themes.
checks.setup: Hip-width stance, hips above knees, both plates start at sole height.
checks.hands: Overhand grips outside legs aligned to shaft; elbows remain approximately 175.6 to 175.8 degrees.
checks.feet: Both feet remain planted; measured drift below 1.1e-14.
checks.movement: 1.6-second pause holds bar 1.22 model units below knee with zero grip drift; resumes ascent and returns without bounce; corrected thigh clearance minimum 0.424.

checks.exercise: Barbell deadlift with deliberately controlled ascent and descent.
checks.equipment: Rigid shaft and equal plates; no crop in either final theme.
checks.setup: Floor start at sole height with neutral torso and bent hips/knees.
checks.hands: Both grips stay aligned with shaft; long arms without curling.
checks.movement: 3.2-second ascent and 3.2-second descent; knee angle extends from 110 to 175 degrees; smooth loop and positive sampled body/shaft clearance.

checks.exercise: Barbell deadlift emphasizing a slower eccentric return.
checks.equipment: One barbell, two plates; visible in light and dark final sheets.
checks.setup: Floor start with feet fixed and hands outside legs.
checks.hands: Overhand grips remain aligned and arms long throughout.
checks.feet: Both soles stay at the same level; plates return to sole height without penetration.
checks.movement: 1.6-second rise versus 5.6-second monotonic descent; hips and knees bend together, no backward lean at top, zero loop discontinuity.
